description: This file defines the implementation of the HttpClient class, which manages HTTP file downloads using libcurl. It includes methods for initializing and cleaning up curl, performing file downloads with optional rate limiting, and providing progress updates via callbacks.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to perform HTTP file downloads, manage curl handle, and track download progress.

methods.name: ~HttpClient()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the curl handle.

methods.name: HttpClient::Status downloadFile(const std::string & url,const std::string & fileName,uint32_t rateLimit)
methods.description: Downloads a file from the specified URL to the given filename with an optional rate limit.

methods.name: size_t progressCb(void * ptr,double dltotal,double dlnow,double ultotal,double ulnow)
methods.description: Callback function to report download progress.

methods.name: size_t write_data(void * ptr,size_t size,size_t nmemb,FILE * stream)
methods.description: Callback function to write received data to file.
